candidates.description: These tokens represent German inflected articles and pronouns in various dative and genitive cases.
This feature vector represents German adverbial and prepositional root morphemes indicating direction, continuity, or togetherness.
This vector activates on common German noun and verb prefixes or initial root fragments.
Common German nominal suffixes and noun-forming endings.
This feature vector represents German word roots and suffixes containing the letter combination "cht".
This vector represents negation, absence, or polarity reversal across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the Scandinavian letter 'ä' or its uppercase equivalent 'Ä'.
These tokens represent German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, or conditional mood.
This vector activates on common German auxiliary and modal verbs.
This vector activates for German words, prefixes, and sub-word tokens starting with the letters "un" or "unt".
